_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 76: 13-16 July 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says America will ride it after but they will be ahead and finance the investing first, that in his opinion there will be a lot of crypto billionaire or multi-millionaire Asians, and that on July the 11th the Lord spoke to them and gave a word about a pipeline coming out of the Kurds.
mentions.quote: they will be ahead and fin the finances of investing first
mentions.falsify_match: Asian investors leading the crypto gains ahead of American ones.
mentions.falsify_miss: None workable. He marks it as his own opinion, and a lot of crypto millionaires somewhere in Asia is satisfied by the existing market.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Rolls-Royces, beautiful homes, palm trees and beautiful things starting to take place, that the Lord said corruption three times over, that he thought it interesting the Lord warned them what was coming on July the 11th, and that they will then see what was in the news yesterday.
mentions.quote: the Lord warned us what was coming on July the 11th
mentions.falsify_match: A pipeline or oil story out of Iraq reported after 11 July and before this broadcast.
mentions.falsify_miss: The reporting predates the word. This one is dated tightly enough on both ends, 11 July to 15 July, to be checked properly, which is unusual for the fulfilment claims in this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him there are three men who are corrupt in the central bank of Iraq and that their hands are going to be forced, identifies a man in a played clip as the one he saw, and the clip has the president praising a new oil partnership among the largest, formed over a very short period, to be announced this week or next, and calling the new prime minister a great leader.
mentions.quote: three men that are corrupt in that bank in the essential bank
mentions.falsify_match: Three central bank officials in Iraq removed or exposed, and the oil partnership announced in that fortnight.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such removals. The announcement window comes from the clip, not from him, but the three corrupt bankers are his and are specific enough to check. Now past due.

mentions.claim_text: He says people are telling him this is what he saw and that it is not, that it is a distraction and what he saw was much worse, that the arrest may be a field goal but it is not the touchdown, that the touchdown is a country and an act of war in retaliation for Soleimani rather than some person on the internet, that these people were trained assassins like Navy Seals who came through Canada by Michigan and not the southern border, and that they are still here.
mentions.quote: these people were trained assassin. I said they came from Canada by Michigan
mentions.falsify_match: A state-backed attack traced to operatives who entered via Canada.
mentions.falsify_miss: None on a date, since none is given. Worth recording that he is explicitly refusing to count a real arrest as his fulfilment, which cuts the other way from most of this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says people will come against the regime, that he saw a flipping of a regime one more time, to pray for Reza, that he saw Reza trying to rise up for a season to lead the Iranian people and then saw them assassinate him, and that it is the same praying over the president of Colombia who takes office next month, whom he saw the cartel coming against very hard.
mentions.quote: I saw Rea trying to rise up for a season to lead the Iranian people
mentions.falsify_match: Regime change in Iran with Reza Pahlavi leading, then killed; and the cartel moving against the incoming Colombian president in August.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither happens. The August date belongs to the Colombian half and is now past due, which makes that half checkable; the Iranian half carries no date at all.

mentions.claim_text: He says that for preaching the truth the First Amendment rights are the first to go, the Lord said especially when it comes to social media, that they are then going to come after the Second Amendment, that he saw these things happening over into 2030, and that he saw a great revival as pressure comes upon the church, seeing an olive press pushing down and fresh olive oil coming off.
mentions.quote: the first one to go, the Lord said, especially when it comes to social media
mentions.falsify_match: Speech restrictions on social media followed by gun restrictions before 2030.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A four and a half year window over two continuously contested areas of American law, with revival under pressure as the fallback reading if the restrictions do not come.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord gave Georgia and Minnesota as their assignments because there was great fraud coming out of Stacy Abrams, that he saw districts in Atlanta that were corrupt through voter fraud with big money funded into it, that they have interceded for Georgia for a week or two, that the Lord said it is over three seats concerning the Senate, and that losing those seats turns the Senate blue and brings great persecution against President Trump, leaving him a stalemate president.
mentions.quote: Three seats concerning the Senate, losing the Senate for this for it to go blue
mentions.falsify_match: The Senate turning on three seats, with Georgia and Minnesota among them.
mentions.falsify_miss: The Senate holds, or turns on a different number or different states. Three seats plus two named states is the tightest form this claim has taken and is properly scoreable in November.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying to hurry because time is running out, that he will give favour to get the job done for his people, to set your sights on it and he will bring it to pass, that he will even cause this to flip in November, to do what he has asked, and asks whether they want more time.
mentions.quote: I'll even cause this to flip in November
mentions.condition_text: if they do what he has asked them to do
mentions.falsify_match: The November result going the way he wants.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The flip is conditioned on obedience to an unstated instruction, so a loss shows the instruction was not followed. Do what I've asked you to do is never specified in the passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Saudi Arabia and other Arab nations coming to help for a percentage of the pie, that he sees the Iraqi oil line already built halfway and needing only to be finished, that with this pipeline with the Kurds he sees a major percentage by the end of his term, and that it is drill baby drill in Iraq with big oil wealth coming like Saudi Arabia.
mentions.quote: This pipeline with the Kurds, I see by the by the end of his term
mentions.time_phrase: by the end of his term
mentions.falsify_match: A Kurdish pipeline completed and Iraqi oil output rising sharply before January 2029.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not completed. A percentage of what is never said, so the magnitude cannot be scored even if the pipeline is finished.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not want to be a conspiracy theorist or go down rabbit holes and that his main job is to pray over President Trump and that they see in part, then introduces a word dated June 18th in which he saw a new attack against President Trump's life, a black mamba and a brown snake, and that a little of this poison would cause something that looks like a stroke or a heart attack, along with a mark like a concentrated cat scratch.
mentions.quote: I saw a new attack against President Trump's life
mentions.falsify_match: The president suffering a stroke or heart attack attributed to poisoning, with a visible scratch.
mentions.falsify_miss: None on a date. The claim is broad enough that any future illness of an elderly man could be read into it, and the poison detail makes an ordinary cardiac event look like the hit.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw churches burning in Europe and churches burning in America, that the Lord named the Brotherhood, that they will start to burn churches but are not expecting the result they are going to get, that he saw a giant rising up out of the church because they poked the bear, and that the church he means is not the charismatics.
mentions.quote: You'll see them start to burn churches
mentions.falsify_match: A campaign of church arson in Europe and America followed by a visible church resurgence.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Church fires occur every year in both places, no rate or threshold is given, and the giant rising is an image with no test attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said it is a giant that would be poked and that he saw churches burning, that as persecution comes on the church in Canada he saw an olive press and the Lord showed it to him again, that he saw an olive press in Europe, and that they will try to bring Agenda 2030 really strong in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: they will try to bring Agenda 2030 really strong in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A visible push on the 2030 agenda alongside church persecution in Canada and Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The days ahead has no end, and a standing UN framework can always be said to be pushed strongly.
